About Motown Luxe

Motown Luxe is a dazzling 6 to 8-piece Motown and R&amp;B band delivering soul-stirring vocals , high-energy grooves , and dancefloor-filling hits from the golden era to now. With setlists packed full of favourites like Think , Higher Ground , Say A Little Prayer , September , and Super Freak , they bring timeless class with party-starting flair . Fronted by charismatic vocalists Rachel and Reniece—both stars of UK theatre tours like The Magic of Motown —the band’s talent runs deep. Rachel’s career spans cruise ships , arenas , and lead roles in West End-style productions, while Reniece’s credits include performances with Justin Timberlake , Gwen Dickey , and the London Community Gospel Choir . Their pro lineup features bass , guitar , keys , drums , and a brass section (sax and trumpet), all full-time musicians trained at top institutions like BIMM and Royal Birmingham Conservatoire . With tailored setlists , full PA and lighting , and a dedicated band manager to handle logistics, Motown Luxe guarantee a slick , soulful , and unforgettable live music experience.
